q: What are the six sections of the Personal AI Playbook?
options: Reports, Emails & messages, Numbers, My-role documents, My privacy rules, My verification checklist
ChatGPT, Gemini, Sheets, Canva, WhatsApp, Calendar
Goals, Budget, Timetable, Contacts, Passwords, Notes
Day 1 to Day 7, in order, with no other sections
explanation: The Playbook holds your real prompts under six headings: Reports, Emails & messages, Numbers and My-role documents, plus My privacy rules and My verification checklist.

q: What is the weekly Playbook review ritual?
options: Rebuild the Playbook from scratch every week
Ten minutes a week: review the AI output, keep what worked, fix one weak prompt
Ask AI to rewrite the whole Playbook daily
Delete prompts you have not used this week
explanation: Once a week, for ten minutes: look at what AI produced, keep what worked and fix one weak prompt. Fixing one prompt each week is the habit that makes the course last.

q: A new AI tool starts trending every few weeks. What does the lesson advise?
options: Chase every new tool and master each one
Keep the same moves and test new tools with your Playbook prompts
Only use tools your friends recommend
explanation: Tools change every month, but the moves (give real material, specify role and format, verify the output) do not. You test new tools with your Playbook, not on the strength of hype.

q: You have a template-extraction prompt from Day 3. Under which Playbook heading does it belong?
explanation: The format-following and template-extraction prompts from Day 3 go under My-role documents, with your Day 6 work product. Filing each prompt under the job it does is what lets you find it again in a hurry.
